notes.title: Update 2.8.1
notes.content:
[h2][b]
Graphical Changes[/b][/h2]
Completely redid the lightning system. Now, fire and lightning skills glow, the player glows, NPCs glow, light skills glow, summons glow, waypoints and portals glow, and mercenaries glow.
Updated the color / appearance of magic and rare items.
Updated the color / appearance of gemmed items.
All gems now have a completely unique image.
Changed the look of a portal stone.
Updated the appearance of storms.
Updated the appearance of all items.
Updated the appearance of the UI, giving a simpler look and feel. Also added artwork to UI design.
Passive skill slots now only appear if you have that slot available.
Reskinned the skill Lightning’s bolts.
Re-re-skinned some gear.
Re-skinned the skill tree.
Changed the font from Poor Richard to Spectral throughout the entire game – including counters and gold indicators.

[h2][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/h2]
Wands and staves can now roll the stats Fireball, Waterball, Iceball, Lightningball, and Poisonball.
Staves can now roll stats twice as powerful as wands.
Storms now occur on the Island of Storms and deal a small amount of damage.
Waypoints are cheaper to craft.
Potions now only stack up to four.
Scrolls of identification and portal stones now stack up to eight.
You can now change skills simply by clicking on them in the main UI. 
Mixed in some new soundtracks.
The first area by the beach is now always raining.
Tree fires can slightly damage the player as well as allies and enemies.
Re-animated the skills Throw, Dual Throw, and Dual Strike.
Fixed the animation of the skill Fireball.
Increased the experience enemies give.
Increased the experience needed to level up at higher levels.
Lowered the mana cost of the skills Strike, Throw and Double Throw.
Greatly increased the damage of the skill Throw.
Remastered the opening cinematic.
Portals and waypoints now appear on the map.
Slightly lowered base mana-regeneration.
Added some more unique items that look pretty sweet, including a one handed sword, a mace, helmet, some chest armor, a few shields, and a pair of boots.
The skill Scorch now only scorches when moving.
Reduced the distant allied summons and mercenaries will go to fight other enemies.
Waterball has been nerfed.
Energy now slightly increases mana regeneration now.
Lowered the drop rate for gems.
[h2][b]
Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
Fixed a bug where mercenaries could not equip gear
Fixed a bug where elemental damage on melee weapons was not working.
Fixed bugs where bosses would kill fellow enemies with their attacks.
Fixed the skill Cleave which would not appropriately dish out damage.
Tweaked the skill Whirlwind.
Fixed a bug where Voltage nodes would leave behind their damage colliders.
Fixed the position of the experience bar.
Fixed the text that appears on hovering over mini-menu buttons.
Fixed the text over the globes.

notes.title: Storms 2: Under the Sun
notes.content:
Storms 2 has had numerous changes. Here are the big ones:

* Performance has had a drastic improvement
* Many items have had a major reskin
* Soundtrack improvements
* Audio improvements
* The UI Has been updated
* Weapons are now grabbed and animated correctly
* Mercenaries can now drink potions, level up, and take orders
* A new quest and boss was added
* New dialogue and voice acting has been implemented
* Bugs have been eradicated
* The game has been through a lot of balancing
* All Maces have been given a 25% stun chance
* Bows have been nerfed
* Two handed weapons have been buffed
* And so much more...

(If you're curious about more thing):
* The skill tree now has precise boundaries
* Some skills on the skill tree did not lead to others as intended - fixed
* Blight has an epic visual effect on the environment
* Grass also has an epic visual effect
* Cursing from an item now works from Mercenaries as well as the player
* Shadow walk and invisibility now appear properly
* Warp was nerfed
* The City of Thieves now stays in one location
* Samander now appears in different gateways to the city
* Samander now is on the left side of the CoT Waypoint
* Twister no longer damages the player
* I promise there is a lot more, I just can't remember all of the changes as of now.

Anyway, enjoy the game! I'm excited and nervous to see what you think. Don't hesitate to post in the discussions. Thanks everybody for sticking with the project!

notes.title: Big Things: Part 1
notes.content:
As a disclaimer, there has been many, many changes to the game and it's possible you may find bugs in this latest version. That being said, another update will follow, focused mainly on graphics, character customization, and more quests. This is what you're getting with Part 1:

[b]Saving and Quitting[/b]
Saving and quitting has not only been fixed, it's been completely reworked to be faster and reliable.

[b]Upgraded Visuals[/b]
* All characters receiving better animations, including the player, mercenaries, enemies, bosses, summons, and city-folk.
* The user interface has been gutted and cleaned up - and it looks great.
* Many items have been reskinned to look better. Part 2 will finish the work for all of the remaining items.
* Skills look much better
* The skill tree and the tree interface have both had upgrades as well.

[b]Reworked Bosses[/b]
Enjoy facing some brand new and re-worked bosses.

[b]Other Added Features[/b]
* Quest guide
* Better UI hotkeys
* Melee enemies can deal elemental damage
* Reworked some skills

The full update will be coming soon.

notes.title: Patch 2.4
notes.content:
The biggest two things about this update:

1) Mercenaries
Mercenaries can be hired, geared up, and renamed - it's not a skill, so any class can purchase them. Give them your cool loot you can't use to make them potent soldiers.

2) The Skill Tree
Every skill icon has been updated graphically, and the entire skill tree has been reskinned. It now glows and it's awesome.

Other than that, there have been the regular bug fixes, including:
* Crafting walls now has a limit
* Stashes can be crafted
* Small and large potions no longer mix

Balancing:
* Nerfed Xetrov

notes.title: Under the Moon
notes.content:
The Storms 2 Under the Moon update is huge.

[b]* The game now features entirely new soundtrack[/b]
  * Over 10 new soundtrack pieces have been added.
[b]* Many, many bugs have been crushed[/b]
  * A lot. 
[b]* Skills, enemies, and items have been re-balanced[/b]
  * Some skills were nerfed, some skills were buffed, the skill tree has been modified
  * "Rabies" is a new skill which enables shapeshifters to deal extra poison damage
  * Plant skills and Poison skills have been switched
[b]* Sound effects were added[/b]
  * Many items and skills have added sound effects
[b]* The graphics have been improved[/b]
  * UI has been reskinned
[b]*Quality-of-life things have been added[/b]
  * A hotkey for dropping or swapping items
  * A hotkey for portal stones
  * Each menu has a hotkey
[b]* Other components of the game were balanced[/b]
  * Potions restore less life and mana
  * Sockets on items have been reduced
  * Enemies were given more health
[b]* A few new enemy types have arrived:[/b]
  * A smaller, quicker unit type
* A "Wind" enemy type which can throw you around
